m-04.title: Ukuthenga izimuncumuncu ngo-5000 won
m-04.goal: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokuhlangabezana neemeko ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ucacise indlela yokuzifumana zonke ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi na nokuba kutheni ezinye iimeko zingenakwenzeka.
m-04.material: Iqela lethu labantu abali-10 lifuna ukuthenga izimuncumuncu zomthendeleko. Iitshiphusi zibiza i-600 won ngengxowa, ijeli ibiza i-400 won ngengxowa, kwaye iziselo zibiza i-500 won ngebhotile. Sichitha i-5000 won ngqo, sithenga ubuncinane enye yazo zontathu, kwaye sithenga ubuncinane izinto ezili-10 ngokupheleleyo ukuze umntu ngamnye abe nenye.
m-04.thinking.2: Ukucacisa iimeko ezingenakwenzeka usebenzisa amanani aqhelekileyo nangaqhelekanga
m-04.prereq.0: Ukubala imali usebenzisa ukuphindaphinda nokudibanisa (Inqanaba lamabanga 3-4)
m-04.s.s1.prompt: Yenza iiplani ezintathu ezahlukileyo zokuthenga ezihlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko.
m-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuba uthenga ezingaphi zohlobo olunye, uze uhlole ukuba ungathenga ezinye ezimbini ngemali eseleyo na.
m-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba isixa sonke sincinci okanye sigqitha i-5000 won, tshintsha inani lohlobo olunye ngenye ngexesha ukulungisa umahluko.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Kufuneka uthenge ubuncinane enye yazo zontathu.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c3: Isixa sonke asiyi-5000 won. Dibanisa imali yohlobo ngalunye ukuhlola.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c4: Zizinto ezingaphantsi kwezili-10 ngokupheleleyo, ngoko umntu ngamnye akakwazi ukuba nenye.
m-04.s.s1.explain: Ngokomzekelo, (iitshiphusi, ijeli, iziselo) = (4, 4, 2) ziyi-2400+1600+1000=5000 won kwaye zizinto ezili-10. (3, 3, 4), (2, 2, 6), (1, 1, 8), (2, 7, 2), kunye (1, 6, 4) nazo zonke ziyahlangabezana neemeko.
m-04.s.s2.prompt: Emva kokufumana indlela enye, ufuna ukufumana ezinye iindlela ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi na. Yeyiphi indlela engcono?
m-04.s.s2.hint.0: Beka iindlela ozifumeneyo etafileni uze ujonge ulandelelwano owazifumana ngalo.
m-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, thelekisa "umgama owukhangelayo emva kokufumana enye" kunye "nokuba ungathetha ukuba uzifumene zonke."
m-04.s.s2.o.a: Misela inani leengxowa zeetshiphusi libe yi-1, 2, 3... ngokulandelelana, uze uyeke kwangoko xa kuphuma indlela enye
m-04.s.s2.r.a: Ukuhamba ngokulandelelana kulungile. Kodwa ukuba uyeka emva kokufumana enye, awukwazi ukuthetha ukuba zikhona ezinye iindlela. Kufuneka uye kude kangangoko unako ukuzifumana zonke ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi.
m-04.s.s2.o.b: Zama ukubala njengoko kuza engqondweni uze ugcine kuphela ezo zenza i-5000 won, uze uyeke xa ungasekho ophumayo
m-04.s.s2.r.b: Unokufumana ezimbalwa. Kodwa awukwazi ukuthetha ukuba "uzifumene zonke." Ukuzifumana zonke ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi, udinga ulandelelwano.
m-04.s.s2.o.c: Misela inani leebhotile zeziselo libe yi-1, 2, 3... ngokulandelelana ude ugqibe, uze ukwenye nenye uhlole ukuba ezinye zingathengwa na ngemali eseleyo
m-04.s.s2.r.c: Yindlela entle. Ukuba ulungisa uhlobo olunye ngokulandelelana ude ugqibe uze uhlole ezinye, ungathetha ukuba usukile kude kangakanani, ngoko ungazifumana zonke ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi.
m-04.s.s2.o.d: Xa isixa sonke sigqithile ku-5000 won, nciphisa zonke iintlobo ezintathu nganye nganye uze ubale kwakhona, uphinde
m-04.s.s2.r.d: Iintlobo ezintathu zinamaxabiso ahlukileyo, ngoko ukuzinciphisa zonke ngokulinganayo akulungisi umahluko. Kulula ukulungisa ngokutshintsha uhlobo olunye ngexesha.
m-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuba ulungisa uhlobo olunye ngokulandelelana, ude ugqibe, uze uhlole ezinye, ungathetha ukuba usukile kude kangakanani, ngoko ungazifumana zonke ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi na. Ngokomzekelo, uhlola ngokumisela iziselo zibe yibhotile e-1, iibhotile ezi-2, iibhotile ezi-3, njalo njalo.
m-04.s.s3.prompt: Umceli-mngeni (kuphela ukuba ufuna ukuzama): Kwiindlela ozifumeneyo, inani leebhotile zeziselo (500 won) liyi-2, 4, 6, okanye 8, lihlala liyipheyiri. Ingaba akukho ndlela yokuthenga inani elingumangqabangqaba leebhotile zeziselo (1, 3, 5...)? Cacisa ngamagama akho isizathu. Ukucinga ngamanani aphelayo nangaphelayo, iiyunithi ze-200 won, okanye itafile konke kulungile.
m-04.s.s3.hint.0: Guqula i-600 won, i-400 won, ne-500 won zibe linani lamaqela e-100 won uze uzibhale njengo-6, 4, no-5.
m-04.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana imali eseleyo xa uthenga ibhotile e-1 neebhotile ezi-3 zeziselo, uze uhlole ukuba ungayenza loo mali ngeetshiphusi nejeli na.
m-04.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ixabiso leetshiphusi nejeli ngu- ... Ukuba inani leebhotile zeziselo lingumangqabangqaba, ...
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ukuba yintoni ekhethekileyo ngemali oyifumana ngokudibanisa amaxabiso eetshiphusi nejeli?
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uqhubekele phambili ubhala isizathu sokuba isixa sonke singabi yi-5000 won xa inani leebhotile zeziselo lingumangqabangqaba?
m-04.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba uqokelela i-600 won ne-400 won ngamaqela e-100 won, ufumana amaqela ayi-6 nawa-4, omabini eyipheyiri. I-5000 won ngamaqela angama-50, eyipheyiri. Isiselo singamaqela angama-5, ngoko ngenani elingumangqabangqaba leebhotile isixa siba ngumangqabangqaba kwaye asinakuba ngama-50, eyipheyiri.
m-04.s.s3.model.1: Ii-chips ezingu-600 won kunye ne-jelly engu-400 won zonke ziziphindaphindi ze-200 won, ngoko isixa sazo sikwayisiphindaphindi se-200. Inani elingaqhelekanga leebhotile zeziselo ngu-500, 1500, 2500..., kwaye ukwahlula nge-200 kushiya u-100. Ngoko ukuzidibanisa akunakwenza u-5000 won.
m-04.s.s3.model.2: Ngebhotile e-1 yeziselo, imali eseleyo ngu-4500 won, kodwa nasiphi na isixa esenziwe nge-600 won kunye ne-400 won siyisiphindaphindi se-200, ngoko u-4500 awunakwenziwa. Ngeebhotile ezi-3 okanye ezi-5, imali eseleyo ayisiyo isiphindaphindi se-200 nayo, ngoko ayisebenzi.

m-02.title: Yintoni enye esiyidingayo ukusombulula le mpazamo?
m-02.goal: Funda ukuba ngaba ingxaki inokusonjululwa okanye hayi akuxhomekekanga ekubeni kukho amanani, kodwa ekubeni ulwazi olufunekayo kwinto ebuzwayo lukhona, khomba ngqo ukuba luluphi ulwazi olusilelayo, kwaye ucacise isizathu sokuba isiphumo sokwahlula kufuneka sigqithiselwe phezulu kuhlulo olunentsalela.
m-02.material:
Abafundi abaya kuhambo lwesikolo bafuna ukwahlukana baye kwiivenkile. Zine iingxaki ezingezantsi.
a) Abafundi abangama-28 bayahlukana bakhwele kwiivenkile. Ivenkile enye inokuthwala abafundi abangama-9 ubuninzi. Zizeziphi ubuncinane iivenkile ezifunekayo?
b) Abafundi abangama-28 baya kuhambo lwesikolo. Imali yokungena ngu-2000 won ngomfundi ngamnye, kwaye intlawulo yokuqesha ivenkile ngu-90000 won ngevenkile nganye. Yimalini eyonke yokungena yabafundi bonke?
c) Abafundi bayahlukana bakhwele kwiivenkile. Ivenkile enye inokuthwala abafundi abangama-9 ubuninzi. Zizeziphi ubuncinane iivenkile ezifunekayo?
d) Abafundi abangama-28 baya kuhambo lwesikolo. Ivenkile enye inokuthwala abafundi abangama-9 ubuninzi. Kuyabiza malini ngokupheleleyo ukuqesha iivenkile?
m-02.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxaki nganye ngokwahlukileyo uze ukhethe zonke ezo ngxaki ezinokuphendulwa usebenzisa ulwazi olukuyo kuphela.
m-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwiingxaki ezine nganye, ngcibilisa phantsi into ebuzwayo.
m-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala phantsi amanani owafunayo ukubala into ebuzwayo, uze uhlole enye ngenye ukuba akwingxaki na. Phawula nawaphi amanani angasetyenziswanga.
m-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba uyiphosile ingxaki a): inabo bobabini abafundi abangama-28 kunye nobunzima beevenkile obungama-9 ngevenkile nganye, ngoko inokusonjululwa.
m-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba uyiphosile ingxaki b): nangona ulwazi olungasetyenziswayo kwisisombululo, njengentlawulo yokuqesha, luxutywe, unokufumana "imali yonke yokungena" ebuzwayo nge-28×2000. Ukuba nolwazi olongezelelekileyo kwahlukile ekungabikho kolwazi.
m-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba ukhethe ingxaki c): nangona amanani enikiwe, kukho ulwazi olufuneka ngokupheleleyo ukufumana impendulo. Hlola kwakhona ukuba ngawaphi amanani owafunayo ukubala into ebuzwayo.
m-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba ukhethe ingxaki d): unokufumana inani leevenkile (4), kodwa ukufumana iindleko ufuna intlawulo yokuqesha ivenkile enye. Le ngxaki ayinalo eli nani.
m-02.s.s1.explain: Ingxaki a) inokusonjululwa kuba inabafundi abangama-28 kunye nobunzima obungama-9 ngevenkile nganye. Ingxaki b) ayisebenzisi ntlawulo yokuqesha, kodwa inokusonjululwa nge "mali yokungena × inani labafundi" (2000×28=56000 won). Ingxaki c) ayithethi bangaphi abafundi, kwaye ingxaki d) ayinikezeli ntlawulo yokuqesha ivenkile enye, ngoko ayinakusonjululwa. Unokusombulula ingxaki nokuba inolwazi olungafunekiyo, kodwa ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo luyasilela, awunakuyisombulula nokuba kukho amanani amaninzi kangakanani.
m-02.s.s2.prompt: Ungambuza ntoni utitshala obhale le ngxaki ukuze ukwazi ukusombulula ingxaki c)?
m-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa amanani engxaki c) namanani engxaki a) macala ngamacala.
m-02.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ukuba luluphi ulwazi olukwingxaki a) kodwa olungekho kwingxaki c).
m-02.s.s2.r.a: Umbuzo omhle. Inani labafundi linani elifuneka ngokupheleleyo kwinto ebuzwayo (inani leevenkile), kwaye lisilele kwingxaki.
m-02.s.s2.r.b: Zingaphi iivenkile ezifunekayo yinto ebuzwayo. Ukubuza into ebuzwayo asingombuzo ofumana ulwazi.
m-02.s.s2.r.c: Olo lwazi sele lukwingxaki c). Phinda ufunde ingxaki uze ufumane ukuba luluphi ulwazi olusilelayo.
m-02.s.s2.r.d: Intlawulo yokuqesha ulwazi olusetyenziswa kuphela emva kokuba uyazi "zingaphi iivenkile." Ayisetyenziswa ukufumana ukuba zingaphi iivenkile ezifunekayo.
m-02.s.s2.explain: Ingxaki c) inobunzima ngevenkile nganye kodwa ayinalo inani lonke labafundi. Udinga inani lonke labafundi kunye nobunzima ngevenkile nganye ukufumana "zingaphi iivenkile."
m-02.s.s3.prompt: Khetha inani labafundi ukuze zifuneke iivenkile ezi-3 ngqo, uze ufumane amanani amathathu ahlukeneyo abafundi asebenzayo. (Ubunzima ngevenkile nganye ngu-9.)
m-02.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana abantu abaninzi abanokuthwalwa iivenkile ezi-2 nabaninzi abanokuthwalwa iivenkile ezi-3.
m-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha inani labafundi uze ubale ngesandla ukuba zingaphi iivenkile ezifunekayo ukubathwala.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Nceda usebenzise inani eliphelele le-1 okanye ngaphezulu njengenani labafundi.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Ngenani elinje labafundi, inani leevenkile aliyi-3. Hlola ubuninzi obunokuthwalwa ziivenkile ezi-3 nokuba ezi-2 ziyaneliseka na.
m-02.s.s3.explain: Iivenkile ezi-2 zinokuthwala ukuya kuthi ga kubafundi abali-18, kwaye iivenkile ezi-3 ukuya kuthi ga kuma-27. Ngoko ukuba kukho abafundi abangama-19 ukuya kuma-27 (iimeko ezi-9), zifuneka iivenkile ezi-3 ngqo.
m-02.s.s4.prompt: Abafundi abangama-27 badinga iivenkile ezi-3, kwaye abafundi abangama-28 badinga iivenkile ezi-4. 28÷9=3.11…, ngoko kutheni kuba ezi-4 hayi ezi-3?
m-02.s.s4.hint.0: Qala ubhale bangaphi abafundi abanokukhwela ukuba zonke iivenkile ezi-3 zizele ngokupheleleyo.
m-02.s.s4.hint.1: Emva koko thelekisa oko nabafundi abangama-28 ubone ukuba ukhona na osalayo.
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingaba inkcazelo yakho iquka ubuninzi obunokuthwalwa iivenkile ezi-3?
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthethe ukuba umfundi osalayo naye kufuneka akhwele kwivenkile?
m-02.s.s4.model.0: Iivenkile ezi-3 zinokuthwala ukuya kuthi ga kubafundi abangama-27 kuphela, ngoko umfundi o-1 uyasala. Lo mfundi o-1 kufuneka akhwele naye, ngoko kufuneka enye ivenkile, nto leyo yenza iivenkile ezi-4.
m-02.s.s4.model.1: Ukuba uyabafaka abafundi abangama-28 kwiivenkile ezi-3, abangama-27 kuphela abanokukhwela kwaye o-1 akakwazi. Ngoko zifuneka iivenkile ezi-4. Awunakungayihoyi nje inxalenye emva kwedesimali.
m-02.s.s4.model.2: Iivenkile ezi-3 azinakubathwala bonke abafundi abangama-28. Nokuba zizele zithwala abangama-27, ngoko umfundi o-1 uyasala kwaye sifuna enye ivenkile.
m-02.s.s4.model.3: 28 yahlulwa ngo-9 yi-3 kunye ne-1 esalayo, kodwa umfundi osalayo kufuneka akhwele naye, ngoko sifuna enye ivenkile.

m-11.title: Kufuneka sazi ntoni ukuze sibe nokumisela ifunksiyon yequadratic?
m-11.goal: Gweba ukuba zeziphi iiseti zenkcazelo ezimisela ifunksiyon yequadratic ngokukodwa, yaye, kwiiseti ezinenkcazelo encinci kakhulu, bonisa iifunksiyon ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ozenzileyo ezanelisa iimeko ukuze wenze isigqibo ukuba yeyiphi inkcazelo eyongezelelweyo efunekayo.
m-11.material: Ufuna ukufumana ulingano lwefunksiyon yequadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a≠0). Phakathi kweeseti zenkcazelo ezingezantsi, ufuna ukufumana ezo apho loo nkcazelo yodwa imisela ulingano ngokukodwa.
m-11.thinking.1: Ukubonisa ukuba inkcazelo ayonelanga ngemizekelo emibini eyahlukeneyo
m-11.prereq.0: Iifomu ezintathu zefunksiyon yequadratic (ifomu esemgangathweni, ifomu yenqaku eliphakamileyo, ifomu elahlulelweyo)
m-11.prereq.2: Ukufaka amachaphaza apho igrafu idlula khona
m-11.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iiseti apho loo nkcazelo yodwa imisela ifunksiyon yequadratic ngokukodwa.
m-11.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-f(x)=ax²+bx+c, qala ubale ukuba mangaphi amaxabiso angaziwayo ofuna ukuwafumana.
m-11.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela ukuba lukhetho ngalunye lunika ulingano olungaphi olwahlukeneyo (iimeko), kwaye ingaba ezo meko zimisela a, b, kunye no-c zonke.
m-11.s.s1.o.a: Inqaku eliphakamileyo, nechaphaza elinye kwigrafu elingelo inqaku eliphakamileyo
m-11.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba yinqaku eliphakamileyo, p no-q zimiselwe kwi-f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, kwaye ichaphaza elinye limisela u-a.
m-11.s.s1.o.b: Amachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo kwigrafu, kunye nenyaniso yokuba igrafu ivuleka ngaphezulu
m-11.s.s1.r.b: Zikho iiparabola ezingapheliyo ezivuleka ngaphezulu ezidlula kumachaphaza amabini. Icala elivulekayo likuxelela uphawu luka-a kuphela, hayi ixabiso luka-a.
m-11.s.s1.o.c: Amachaphaza amabini apho idibana khona ne-x-axis, kunye nolungelelwaniso lwe-x lwenqaku eliphakamileyo
m-11.s.s1.r.c: Ikhowudinethi ye-x yencopho ikwisiqingatha ngqo phakathi kweendawo ezimbini zokunqumla i-x, ngoko asilulwazi olutsha. a isashiyekile. Zama ukuphindaphinda (x−1)(x−3) ngo-2 okanye −5.
m-11.s.s1.o.d: Amachaphaza amathathu kwigrafu anamakhowudinethi e-x ahlukeneyo
m-11.s.s1.r.d: Amachaphaza amathathu anika iikhweshini ezintathu ezizimeleyo ku-a, b, no-c, ngoko imiselwa ngokungafaniyo.
m-11.s.s1.o.e: Ikhweshini yomgca wokulinganisa nendawo yokunqumla i-y
m-11.s.s1.r.e: Umgca wokulinganisa umisela ubudlelwane obunye phakathi kuka-a no-b, kwaye indawo yokunqumla i-y imisela c. Bala ukuba onke amaxabiso amathathu a, b, no-c amisiwe na.
m-11.s.s1.o.f: Amachaphaza amabini apho idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x, nenye indawo kwigrafu
m-11.s.s1.r.f: Kwi-f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), p no-q bamiselwe, kwaye ichaphaza elinye limisela u-a.
m-11.s.s1.explain: Zikho izingaziwayo ezintathu, a, b, no-c, ngoko udinga iimeko ezintathu ezizimeleyo. D: amachaphaza amathathu anika iikhweshini ezintathu ezidibeneyo. A: incopho imisela p no-q kwi-f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, kwaye ichaphaza elinye limisela u-a. F: p no-q bamiselwe kwi-f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), kwaye ichaphaza elinye limisela u-a. B, C, no-E zineemeko ezimbini ezizimeleyo kuphela, ngoko a isashiyekile. (Ukuba amachaphaza amathathu akumgca othe ngqo, akukho msebenzi wequadratic ukhoyo, ngoko phantsi kwemeko yokuba ngumsebenzi wequadratic, amachaphaza amathathu akekho kumgca othe ngqo.)

m-06.title: Ukujonga isisombululo sikaSeoyeon
m-06.goal: Funda ukuba ukwahlula macala omabini olingano ngentetho enokwahluka kunganciphisa isisombululo ukuba ugqithise ukuba isenokuba yi-0, ulungise isisombululo, uze wenze ulingano apho kwenzeka into efanayo.
m-06.material: USeoyeon wasombulula ulingano x² (x isikwere) = 3x ngale ndlela. Jonga isisombululo umqolo omnye ngexesha ujonge ukuba sichanekile.
m-06.thinking.0: Ukufumana apho nesizathu sokuba impazamo ikwisisombululo
m-06.thinking.2: Ukwenza imeko apho kwenzeka impazamo efanayo
m-06.prereq.0: Ukusombulula ulingano lweqwadrathi ngokwahlula zibe zizinto ezibalayo (inqanaba loBanga 9)
m-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umqolo omnye kweso sisombululo ongenakuwuthemba. (Unokukhetha umqolo onenyathelo elingalunganga, okanye umqolo obhalwe kuwo isiphelo esingalunganga ngenxa yalo.)
m-06.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga umqolo omnye ngexesha ukuba ngaba umqolo ngamnye ulandela ngokufanelekileyo kumqolo osemva kwawo ngqo.
m-06.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukufaka x = 0 kulingano lwantlandlolo x² = 3x ubone ukuba luyasebenza na.
m-06.s.s1.line.1: Wahlula macala omabini nge-x ufumane x = 3
m-06.s.s1.line.2: Ukutshintshela x = 3 kunika 3² = 9 kunye no-3×3 = 9, ngoko kuyasebenza.
m-06.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko sisombululo esinye kuphela salolu lingano x = 3.
m-06.s.s1.explain: Oko ukubonayo kuxhomekeke kumqolo owukhethileyo. Ukuba ukhethe umqolo wesi-3 (ukutshintshela): loo mqolo ngumbalo ochanekileyo. Kodwa ukutshintshela kubonisa kuphela ukuba "3 sisisombululo"; akubonisi ukuba "akukho zisombululo ezinye." Ukuba ukhethe umqolo ongu-1: ululingano lwantlandlolo, ngoko akukho ngxaki. Iindawo ezingalunganga ngumqolo wesi-2 nowesi-4. Kumqolo wesi-2, macala omabini aye ahlulwa nge-x, kodwa x isenokuba yi-0, kwaye awunakwahlula nge-0. Ngoko isisombululo x = 0 satshabalala, kwaye ngenxa yoko isiphelo esingalunganga somqolo wesi-4, "sisisombululo esinye kuphela esi-3," savela.
m-06.s.s2.prompt: Fumana zonke izisombululo zika x² = 3x ngokuchanekileyo, uze ucacise apho isisombululo sikaSeoyeon sasilahlekile khona.
m-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala uhlobo olufumana xa uthatha zonke amalungu uwasa macala uthe uwahlule abe zizinto ezibalayo.
m-06.s.s2.hint.1: Beka isisombululo sikaSeoyeon nesisombululo sakho macala ngamacala uze ufumane indawo apho izisombululo zihluke khona.
m-06.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba ndihambisa amalungu ndize ndilolule, ...
m-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ujonge ngokufaka x = 0 no-x = 3 kulingano lwantlandlolo?
m-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba inkcazelo yakho ibandakanya inqaku lokuba "xa wahlula macala omabini ngentetho, kufuneka kuqala ujonge ukuba intetho ayiyi-0"?
m-06.s.s2.model.0: x²−3x=0, x(x−3)=0, ngoko x=0 okanye x=3. Xa kwahlulwa macala omabini nge-x, x ibisenokuba yi-0, kwaye awunakwahlula nge-0, ngoko ndilahlekelwe sisisombululo x=0.
m-06.s.s2.model.1: Kukho izisombululo ezimbini, i-0 ne-3. I-x=0 iyasebenza nayo xa ifakwa kulingano lwantlandlolo, 0=0, kodwa xa macala omabini ahlulwa nge-x, imeko ye-x=0 yanyamalala.
m-06.s.s3.prompt: Yenza ulingano ezimbini zeqwadrathi ezahlukileyo ax² + bx + c = 0 apho kwenzeka into efanayo nakwiSeoyeon. Iimeko: lulingano lweqwadrathi, ukwahlula macala omabini nge-x kukwenza ulahlekelwe sisisombululo x = 0, kwaye esinye isisombululo akufuneki sibe yi-0. (a, b, no-c ngamanani aphelele.)
m-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ngawaphi amalungu aseleyo xa ufaka x = 0 kwi-ax² + bx + c = 0.
m-06.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa nohlobo olufumana xa uhambisa ulingano lukaSeoyeon x² = 3x lwaya kwicala elinye, uze uthelekise amaxabiso e-a, b, no-c.

m-06.s.s3.fail.c1: A kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele elingelo-0, kwaye b no-c kufuneka nazo zibe ngamanani aphelele.
m-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Ulingano luyasebenza nokuba utshintshela x = 0. Ngoko ukwahlula nge-x kukwenza ulahlekelwe sisisombululo se-0.
m-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Tshintshela x = 0. Ngaba ulingano luyasebenza? Ukuba aluyi, i-0 asisosisombululo, ngoko akukho sisombululo onokusilahlekelwa.
m-06.s.s3.fail.c3: Ukuba b ngu-0, sisombululo esinye kuphela yi-0. Lutshintshe ube lulingano apho esinye isisombululo singeyiyo i-0.
m-06.s.s3.explain: Ukuze x = 0 ibe sisisombululo, xa ufaka i-0 endaweni ye-x, kuseleyo ilungu elingatshintshiyo c kuphela, ngoko c = 0 iyafuneka. Umzekelo, x² − 3x = 0 kunye no-2x² − 4x = 0 zombini zilahlekelwa sisisombululo se-0 ukuba wahlula nge-x. Kwizilinganiso ezinje, kukhuselekile ukusombulula ngokukhupha i-x njengesiqhulo esiqhelekileyo.

m-09.title: Ivavanywe yaba yipositivu. Lingakanani ithuba lokuba inesiphene?
m-09.goal: Tshintsha uvavanyo lwakho lwethuba lokuba nesiphene ngalo lonke ixesha lisiza isiphumo esitsha sovavanyo, uze ucacise ukuba kutheni uqikelela ngaphezulu ithuba ukuba ungayihoyi izinga lokuqala lesiphene (ithuba langaphambili).
m-09.material: I-2% yeemveliso ezenziwa efektri zinesiphene. Umvavanyi uphawula imveliso enesiphene "ipositivu" (uphawu oluthetha ukuba inesiphene) ngethuba le-90%, kwaye uphawula nemveliso eqhelekileyo ngempazamo "ipositivu" ngethuba le-5%. Uphawu oluthetha ukuba ayinasiphene "yinegetivu." Xa sele kumisiwe ukuba imveliso inesiphene okanye iqhelekile, cinga ukuba nokuba uvavanya loo mveliso amaxesha amaninzi, iziphumo zovavanyo azichaphazelani.
m-09.thinking.0: Ukuhlaziya uvavanyo lwethuba njengoko inkcazelo ikhula
m-09.thinking.1: Ukuthelekisa ingqiqo nokubala kwethuba elixhomekeke kwimeko
m-09.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yethuba elixhomekeke kwimeko (inqanaba lamathuba nenkcazelo yamanani)
m-09.s.s1.prompt: Iziphumo zovavanyo ziveziwa enye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha malunga nokuba kunokwenzeka kangakanani ukuba imveliso inesiphene.
m-09.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba kukho iimveliso ezingama-1000, uqale ubhale ukuba zingaphi ezinesiphene nokuba zingaphi eziqhelekileyo.
m-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba mingaphi imveliso enesiphene nemveliso eqhelekileyo enika isiphumo esibuzwayo (ipositivu, ezimbini zepositivu, njalo njalo).
m-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Lingakanani ithuba lokuba le mveliso inesiphene?
m-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Kwiimveliso ezingama-1000, ezingama-20 zinesiphene kwaye ezingama-980 ziqhelekile. Kwezi zingama-20 zinesiphene, i-90%, engama-18, zipositivu, yaye kwezi zingama-980 eziqhelekileyo, i-5%, engama-49, nazo zipositivu. Kwezi ipositivu ezingama-67, ezingama-18 zinesiphene ngokwenene, ngoko linga-27%. Zininzi iimveliso eziqhelekileyo, ngoko nokuba umvavanyi uchane kakhulu, ithuba liphuma liphantsi.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izinga lesiphene li-2%, ngoko libonakala liphantsi, kodwa inkcazelo yokuba isiphumo sasipositivu inyusa ithuba.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kwezi ipositivu ezingama-67 kwezingama-1000, ezingama-18 zinesiphene, nto ehambelana nexabiso olibalileyo.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I-90% "lithuba lokuba imveliso enesiphene ipositivu." "Ithuba lokuba imveliso epositivu inesiphene" lixabiso elahlukileyo. Cinga ngenyaniso yokuba zininzi kakhulu iimveliso eziqhelekileyo.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ibonakala iphezulu ngenxa yokuchaneka komvavanyi. Cinga ukuba kukho iimveliso ezingama-1000 zizonke ubale ukuba zingaphi ipositivu eziphumayo.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Imveliso efanayo yavavanywa kanye ngakumbi, yaza yaba "yipositivu" kwakhona.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kwezingama-20 ezinesiphene kwezingama-1000, 0.9×0.9=0.81, oko kukuthi 16.2, zipositivu kabini, yaye kwezingama-980 eziqhelekileyo, 0.05×0.05=0.0025, oko kukuthi 2.45, zipositivu kabini. 16.2÷(16.2+2.45)≈0.87, ngoko linga-87%. Ipositivu enye ibuthathaka, kodwa ipositivu ezilandelelanayo zinyusa ithuba kakhulu.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Imveliso eqhelekileyo nayo inokuba yipositivu kabini ilandelelana (0.05×0.05). Jonga ukuba zingaphi.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ipositivu yesibini yinkcazelo entsha. Ukuba ubala kuphela iimeko ezipositivu kabini zilandelelana, ulwabiwo lweemveliso ezinesiphene lutshintsha njani?
m-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Linyukile ukusuka kwi-27% yokuqala, kodwa linokunyuka ngaphezulu. Bala ngesandla kuphela iimeko ezipositivu zombini.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Oku kuhambelana nexabiso olifumene ngokubala iimeko ezipositivu zombini (malunga ne-87%).
m-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwezingama-20 ezinesiphene, ipositivu-ipositivu-inegetivu yi-0.9×0.9×0.1=0.081, oko kukuthi 1.62, yaye kwezingama-980 eziqhelekileyo, ipositivu-ipositivu-inegetivu yi-0.05×0.05×0.95=0.002375, oko kukuthi 2.3275. 1.62÷(1.62+2.3275)≈0.41, ngoko linga-41%. Inkcazelo entsha inokunyusa okanye yehlise ithuba.
m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Oku kuhambelana nexabiso olifumene ngokuthelekisa iimveliso ezinesiphene ezingama-1.62 neziqhelekileyo ezingama-2.33 ezinika ipositivu-ipositivu-inegetivu (malunga ne-41%).
m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Enye inegetivu yesithathu yinkcazelo ehlisa ithuba lokuba nesiphene. Lingakanani ithuba lokuba imveliso enesiphene ibe yinegetivu?
m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Nangona kuphume inegetivu enye, ezimbini zokuqala zipositivu aziphumi. Kwenzeka ntoni xa uthatha zonke iziphumo ezintathu?
m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukujonga inegetivu yesithathu yodwa, kubonakala ngathi kufuneka lehle, kodwa sele kukho ezimbini zepositivu ngaphambi kwayo. Bala iimeko ezinika ipositivu-ipositivu-inegetivu kwicala elinesiphene nakwicala eliqhelekileyo, uze uthelekise.
m-09.s.s1.reflect: Kuvavanyo olunintathu, ithuba lokuba nesiphene litshintshe ukusuka kwi-27% laya kwi-87% laya kwi-41%. Isiphumo sovavanyo ngalunye sasisusa ithuba kweyiphi indlela, kwaye kutheni? Yintoni eshiywe yingqiqo yakho yokuqala ye-90%?
m-09.s.s2.prompt: Cacisela umhlobo okholelwa ukuba "Umvavanyi ubamba i-90% yeemveliso ezinesiphene, ngoko ukuba ipositivu, kuninzi kakhulu ngama-90% okanye ngaphezulu ukuba inesiphene" ukuba kutheni kungenjalo.
m-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kwiimveliso ezingama-1000, wahlule iimveliso eziphuma zipositivu zibe zinesiphene neziqhelekileyo uze uzibale.
m-09.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kwezo mveliso zipositivu, bala ulwabiwo lwezo zinesiphene ngokwenene.
m-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wahlule "ithuba lokuba imveliso enesiphene ibe yipositivu" ku "thuba lokuba imveliso epositivu ibe nesiphene" kwingcaciso yakho?
m-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthethe ngenani leemveliso eziqhelekileyo eziphuma zipositivu?
m-09.s.s2.model.0: Iimveliso ezinesiphene zi-2% kuphela ekuqaleni, oko kukuthi 20 kwezingama-1000. Kwezingama-980 eziqhelekileyo, i-5%, engama-49, nazo ziphuma zipositivu. Kwezi ipositivu ezingama-67, ezingama-18 zinesiphene ngokwenene, ngoko linga-27%.
m-09.s.s2.model.1: Nokuba umvavanyi ungu-90%, zininzi kakhulu iimveliso eziqhelekileyo, ngoko zininzi iimveliso eziqhelekileyo kodwa zipositivu kuneemveliso ezinesiphene zaye zipositivu. Ngoko ipositivu enye ayenzi ithuba libe li-90%.
m-09.s.s2.model.2: Iimveliso ezinesiphene zinqabile kakhulu yaye iimveliso ezininzi ziqhelekile, ngoko inani leemveliso eziphawulwe ngempazamo zipositivu nangona ziqhelekile linokuba likhulu kunenani lepositivu ezinesiphene ngokwenene. Ngoko nokuba ipositivu, ithuba lokuba nesiphene alikho phezulu.

m-01.title: Ukujonga ibango "Ukuphindaphinda rhoqo kwenza kube kukhulu"
m-01.goal: Funda ukuba imizekelo embalwa ayinakuqinisekisa "rhoqo," uze wakhe imizekelo yakho echasayo apho imveliso ingekho nkulu kunenani lokuqala, uze uthi ixesha imveliso iba nkulu ngalo.
m-01.material: UMinji wathi, "Ukuphindaphinda kwenza izinto zibe zinkulu. 3×4=12 inkulu kune-3, 5×2=10 inkulu kune-5, kwaye 7×6=42 inkulu kune-7. Ngoko nokuba uphindaphinda ngalo naliphi inani, isiphumo sihlala sikhulu kunenani oqale ngalo!"
m-01.thinking.0: Ukukhangela ukuba isigqibo sibanzisiwe ngokugqithisileyo nokuba kukho imizekelo emininzi
m-01.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda amanani apheleleyo ngamadesimali (inqanaba lamabanga 5-6, umz. 8×0.5)
m-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umgca kwingxoxo kaMinji onzima ukuwukholelwa? Khetha umgca omnye.
m-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ukhangele ukuba ikhompyutha nganye kwezintathu ilungile na.
m-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala phantsi amanani uMinji aphindaphinde ngawo, 4, 2, no-6, ecaleni kwecala ubone ukuba anantoni efanayo.
m-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko nokuba uphindaphinda ngalo naliphi inani, isiphumo sihlala sikhulu kunenani oqale ngalo.
m-01.s.s1.explain: Oko ukubonayo kuxhomekeke kumgca owukhethileyo. Ukuba ukhethe omnye wemigca emithathu yokuqala: leyo migca ilungile kwikhompyutha nasekuthelekiseni. Ingxaki ayikho "Ngaba imizekelo ilungile?" kodwa "Ungaya kude kangakanani ngemizekelo embalwa nje?" Umgca wokugqibela yiwo ophosakeleyo. UMinji wajonga kuphela imizekelo emithathu apho amanani aphindaphinde ngawo, 4, 2, no-6, onke ayinto efanayo, wathi emva koko "nokuba uphindaphinda ngalo naliphi inani, rhoqo." Nokuba kukho imizekelo emininzi, ukuba likho uhlobo lwenani olungavavanywanga, "rhoqo" alikho qinisekiso.
m-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imizekelo emibini enabaphindaphindi abahlukeneyo ebonisa ukuba ibango likaMinji alilunganga. Sebenzisa inani eliphelele le-1 okanye ngaphezulu njengenani lokuqala nenani elikhulu kune-0 njengomphindaphindi (inani eliphelele okanye idesimali iyavunyelwa), kwaye imveliso akufuneki ibe nkulu kunenani lokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.hint.0: UMinji uvavanye kuphela abaphindaphindi abangu-4, 2, no-6. Khetha uhlobo lwenani olungekavavanywa uluphindaphinde ngenani lokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukutshintsha umphindaphindi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo, uthelekise imveliso nganye nenani lokuqala, ufune amatyala apho ingabi nkulu.
m-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani lokuqala linani eliphelele le-1 okanye ngaphezulu.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda usebenzise inani eliphelele le-1 okanye ngaphezulu njengenani lokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Nceda usebenzise inani elikhulu kune-0 njengomphindaphindi. (I-0 ishiyiwe kwesi senzo.)
m-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Imveliso ayizange ibe nkulu kunenani lokuqala. Ibango likaMinji liyaphukile.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Imveliso yaba nkulu. Yithelekise nenani lokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, 8×0.5=4 incinci kune-8, kwaye 6×1=6 ilingana ne-6. Zombini ngamatyala apho "ingabi nkulu." Nomzekelo omnye ochasayo wanele ukophula "rhoqo."
m-01.s.s3.prompt: Xa uphindaphinda inani lokuqala (inani elikhulu kune-0) ngelinye inani, sesiphi isitatimenti esichaza ngqo, singashiyi nantoni na, ixesha isiphumo siba nkulu ngalo kunenani lokuqala?
m-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tshintsha umphindaphindi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo wenze itheyibhile ye-(inani lokuqala)×(umphindaphindi).
m-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kwitheyibhile, hlula imigca apho isiphumo sikhulu kunenani lokuqala kwimigca apho sikhulu, ujonge into eyahlukileyo ngabaphindaphindi.
m-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba umphindaphindi mkhulu kune-1, isiphumo siba sikhulu; ukuba yi-1, sihlala sinjalo; ukuba ukwi-0 ukuya kwi-1, siba sincinci. Olu khetho luchaza loo mda ngqo.
m-01.s.s3.r.b: Amanani apheleleyo abandakanya i-1. Khangela okwenzekayo nge-8×1 uze ulungise esi sitatimenti.
m-01.s.s3.r.c: Amanye amadesimali, njenge-1.5, makhulu kune-1, kwaye amanye, njenge-0.5, mancinci. Ukuba yidesimali yodwa akumiseli.
m-01.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba mkhulu kune-2, isiphumo siba sikhulu ngokuqinisekileyo, kodwa amanye amanani amancinci kune-2, njenge-1.5, nawo akwenza kube kukhulu. Oku akugqubi onke amatyala apho siba sikhulu.
m-01.s.s3.r.e: Nokuba inani lokuqala likhulu, ukuphindaphinda nge-0.5 kwenza kube kuncinci. Umphindaphindi umisela ukuba isiphumo siba sikhulu na.

m-10.title: Ukuba f'(a)=0, ingaba yi-extremum?
m-10.goal: Sebenzisa idatha yotshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative njengobungqina bokugweba isibakala esithi "Ukuba f'(a)=0, yi-extremum," yakha umzekelo ochasayo, uze uchaze imeko yokuba ibe yi-extremum.
m-10.material:
U-Jihun wathi, "Kwifunksiyon f, ukuba f'(a)=0, ngoko inayo i-extremum (ubuninzi okanye ubuncinane) kwi-x=a." Ukhangele uphawu lwe-derivative f'(x) yeefunksiyon ezintathu kufutshane no-x=0.
Ifunksiyon | f'(x) | f'(−1) | f'(−0.1) | f'(0) | f'(0.1) | f'(1)
f(x)=x² | 2x | − | − | 0 | + | +
f(x)=x³ | 3x² | + | + | 0 | + | +
f(x)=−x⁴ | −4x³ | + | + | 0 | − | −
(+ kunye ne-− kwitheyibhile ziimpawu zamaxabiso e-derivative. Funda x², x³, kunye ne-−x⁴ njenge "x esikwereni," "x ekhyubhini," kunye "ne-x egatywe okune enegetivu.")
m-10.prereq.1: Uphawu lwe-derivative, ukwanda nokunciphisa, intsingiselo yobuninzi nobuncinane (inqanaba le-calculus)
m-10.s.s1.prompt: Jonga itheyibhile ukhethe zonke iifunksiyon ozigwebayo ukuba zine-extremum (ubuninzi okanye ubuncinane) kwi-x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kwifunksiyon nganye, thelekisa iimpawu ze-f' ekhohlo nasekunene ka-x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa inyaniso yokuba xa uphawu lutshintsha, ifunksiyon itshintsha ukusuka ekwandeni iye ekuncitsheni (okanye ngokuchaseneyo).
m-10.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba uphosise i-x²: uphawu lwe-f' lutshintsha ukusuka ku-− lube yi-+. Yindawo apho ifunksiyon isuka ekuncitsheni iye ekwandeni, ngoko bubuncinane.
m-10.s.s1.r.b: Uphawu lwe-f'(x) yi-+ phambi nasemva ko-x=0. Iyanda, ime okomzuzwana ku-0, yaye iphinda inda, ngoko ayiyiyo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba uphosise i-−x⁴: uphawu lwe-f' lutshintsha ukusuka ku-+ lube yi-−. Yindawo apho ifunksiyon isuka ekwandeni iye ekuncitsheni, ngoko bubuninzi.
m-10.s.s1.explain: Kwi-x², uphawu lwe-f' lutshintsha ukusuka ku-− lube yi-+, ngoko bubuncinane, yaye kwi-−x⁴, lutshintsha ukusuka ku-+ lube yi-−, ngoko bubuninzi. Kwi-x³, f'(0)=0 kodwa uphawu aluntshintshi, ngoko ayiyiyo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.prompt: Ngowuphi umgwebo ofanelekileyo ngakumbi malunga nesibakala sika-Jihun esithi "Ukuba f'(a)=0, ngoko kukho i-extremum kwi-x=a"?
m-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ukuba isibakala sithi "ihlala," cinga ukuba yintoni eyenza ibe ngelilungisiweyo xa kukho nemeko enye.
m-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kwifunksiyon nganye kwitheyibhile, thelekisa iimpawu ze-f' phambi nasemva ko-x=0 xa f'(0)=0.
m-10.s.s2.o.a: Yinyani. Zonke iifunksiyon ezintathu kwitheyibhile zine-f'(0)=0, ngoko zine-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.r.a: Zonke iifunksiyon ezintathu zine-f'(0)=0, kodwa ezimbini kuphela zine-extremum. Khangela zonke iziphumo kwitheyibhile.
m-10.s.s2.o.b: Ayiyonyani. Nokuba f'(0)=0, kukho ifunksiyon kwitheyibhile engenayo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.r.b: Ubonise ngomzekelo omnye ochasayo ukuba "ihlala" ayiyonyani.
m-10.s.s2.o.c: Yinyani. Ezimbini kwezintathu iifunksiyon kwitheyibhile zine-extremum, ngoko iyasebenza kuninzi lwazo.
m-10.s.s2.r.c: Isibakala esithi "ihlala" asiyi kuba yinyani ngenxa yokuba sisebenza kwiimeko ezininzi. Khangela ukuba ikho imeko enye apho singasebenzi khona.
m-10.s.s2.o.d: Ayinakugwetywa. Zintathu kuphela iifunksiyon kwitheyibhile, ngoko kunzima ukwenza isigqibo.
m-10.s.s2.r.d: Nokuba kunqongophele iifunksiyon, ukuba kukho umzekelo omnye ochasayo, ungagweba ukuba "ihlala" ayiyonyani. Khangela ukuba ingaba umzekelo ochasayo ukwitheyibhile.
m-10.s.s2.explain: f(x)=x³ ine-f'(0)=0 kodwa ayiyiyo i-extremum, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo. Isibakala esithi "sihlala sisebenza" siba ngelilungisiweyo ngomzekelo omnye nje ochasayo.
m-10.s.s3.prompt: Yenza iifunksiyon ezimbini zekhyubhiki f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (iikoyifishenti zamanani apheleleyo) ezinamaxabiso ahlukeneyo ka-a, apho f'(0)=0 kodwa akukho extremum kwi-x=0.
m-10.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-f'(x) ngokwe-a, b, kunye no-c, uze ufumane u-f'(0).
m-10.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba kutheni i-x³ kwitheyibhile ingazange ibe yi-extremum (uphawu lwe-f') nokuba yahluka njani kwi-x².
m-10.s.s3.ok.c1: Yifunksiyon yekhyubhiki kwaye iikoyifishenti zingamanani apheleleyo.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c1: a kufuneka libe linani eliphelele elingelo-0, kwaye b, c, kunye no-d nabo kufuneka babe ngamanani apheleleyo.
m-10.s.s3.ok.c3: f'(x)=3ax², ngoko uphawu aluntshintshi phambi nasemva ko-x=0.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Uphawu lwe-f'(x) lutshintsha phambi nasemva ko-x=0, ngoko i-extremum iyenziwa. Jonga uphawu kufutshane no-x=0 kwi-f'(x)=x(3ax+2b).
m-10.s.s3.explain: f'(x)=3ax²+2bx+c, ngoko f'(0)=c. Ukuba c=0, ngoko f'(x)=x(3ax+2b), kwaye ukuba b≠0, uphawu luyatshintsha kufutshane no-x=0 yaye i-extremum iyenziwa. Ukuba b=0, ngoko f'(x)=3ax², ngoko uphawu lufana phambi nasemva ko-x=0 yaye ayiyiyo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s4.prompt: Ufuna ukulungisa isibakala sika-Jihun ngokufanelekileyo. Kwi-"Ukuba f'(a)=0 kwaye ______, ngoko inayo i-extremum kwi-x=a," bhala imeko eya kuma kwindawo engenanto.
m-10.s.s4.hint.0: Kwi-x² nakwi-−x⁴ (iimeko ezi-extremum) nakwi-x³ (imeko engeyiyo), thelekisa ukuba uphawu lwe-f' lwahluka njani phambi nasemva ko-x=0.
m-10.s.s4.hint.1: Bhala icala ngecala iimpawu ezikhohlo nasekunene ko-x=0 kwi-x² nakwi-x³, ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye ukuba yintoni eyahlukileyo.
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uyibhale njengemeko ethelekisa ikhohlo nekunene ka-x=a?
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba imeko ikhupha imeko ye-x³, apho f'(x)=0 kwi-x=0 kodwa ayiyiyo i-extremum?
m-10.s.s4.model.0: Uphawu lwe-f'(x) lutshintsha phambi nasemva ko-x=a.
m-10.s.s4.model.1: Yimeko apho, ekhohlo ka-x=a, iyanda yaye ngasekunene itshintshele ekuncitsheni (okanye ngokuchaseneyo), oko kukuthi apho ukwanda nokuncipha kutshintsha khona.
m-10.s.s4.model.2: Ekhohlo nasekunene ka-x=a, i-f'(x) itshintsha ukusuka ku-+ iye ku-− okanye ukusuka ku-− iye ku-+.
m-10.s.s4.modelNote.3: Olu luvavanyo lwe-derivative yesibini. Yimeko eyaneleyo kodwa ayiyo imeko eyimfuneko.

m-08.title: Fumana onke onxantathu abanomjikelezo we-12

m-08.thinking.2: Ukucacisa isizathu sokuba uzifumene zonke ungagqithisanga nanye

m-08.s.s1.hint.0: Beka umgxingxo omde kakhulu, we-6cm, emhlabeni, uze umise eminye imigxingxo emibini ngaphezulu emacaleni omabini ukuze ithinteke.

m-08.s.s1.r.c: Unokucinga ngayo ngokuthelekisa ubude bemiqhagamshelo, ungazobanga. Bubuphi ubude ekufuneka bathelekiswe?
m-08.s.s1.explain: Nokuba udibanisa imiqhagamshelo emibini ye-3cm, ubude buyi-6cm, ifana nomqhagamshelo we-6cm. Imiqhagamshelo emibini ilala ngokulinganayo phezu komqhagamshelo we-6cm kwaye akukho ngongoma yenziwayo, ngoko ayenzi unxantathu.
m-08.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ufake onke onxantathu abahlukeneyo abanomjikelezo we-12cm apho bonke ubude bamacala bungamanani apheleleyo. (Onxantathu abamacala abahlukile kuphela ngolandelelwano babalwa njengonxantathu omnye.)
